mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the projector made its place beneath the panel clear and brought two constructions together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pulley was less satisfying because the resulting description did not clearly distinguish the added part.

surprise.text: A tan box appeared in the description after fitting the dock, before the projector was mounted.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, though the belt’s described path was unclear.

continue.text: I would probably not continue: the instructions were clear, but this chapter’s final result offered little sense of the combined creation working. Text alone cannot establish how recognizable the artwork is or how the toy feels.
